gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-trykker: Expressive from the first letter, Bruno Ace SC spaces its glyphs out like beads on a thread. Trykker, a text serif, brings the literary quiet, with only a slight thick-thin shift to its strokes.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-uchen: Bruno Ace SC holds every line at one width, even through the turns. Uchen, a text serif, does the opposite job well, with stroke weights that differ just enough to feel alive and curves that welcome the eye.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-vollkorn-sc: Bruno Ace SC draws each line like a marker, constant in width and loose across the line. Vollkorn SC does its best work in a modest thick-thin rhythm through each word, with terminals cut short of the bowl.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-yuji-syuku: Bold geometry, then a gentle hand. Bruno Ace SC is best at identical bar thickness across a line, while Yuji Syuku, a text serif, does its best with slight, rubbery modulation and curved strokes that end before turning inward.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-ibm-plex-serif: Authoritative but quietly corporate, this pairing starts with a loud heading. Bruno Ace SC excels at stroke ends as wide as the middle, while IBM Plex Serif offers a faint but real thick-thin shift.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-gf-epunda-slab: Pencil-sketch lines, stout as pipe cleaners, sit over something sturdier. Cabin Sketch never thickens or thins its strokes, and Epunda Slab, a classic serif, brings a dignified, gaping c and rounded lowercase that feel grounded beside it.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders and descenders, and a generous entry into the e. Cabin Sketch, glowing like neon tube at one steady line thickness, is the loud, distinctive half of the pair.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-gf-graduate: Cabin Sketch is stout as a drawn pipe cleaner, and best when it plays the tall, flattened display voice. Graduate, a classic serif, does its best with generous white between letters and capitals barely taller than its lowercase.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-gf-kadwa: Stout, sketchy letters up top, joins as thick as the strokes. Kadwa, a text serif, then reads with a large x-height and open-ended curves, which keeps a long passage moving smoothly.
gen-gf-cabin-sketch-gf-noticia-text: Tall, flattened letters with identical bar thickness make Cabin Sketch the bold voice here. Noticia Text, a serif, quietly handles the reading with big entrances into curves.
